searchText: Hey everyone, ultrasound.money team here. I heard there was some concern raised in the last acd regarding lack of testing of the relay path for epbs. FYI: We have been running our relay on devnet-8 for a while now, mainly testing the builder facing endpoints with our own dummy / test builder. In absense of any direct connected proposers we published bids via p2p, to test our win / reveal cycle. Our staked builder: https://dora.glamsterdam-devnet-8.ethpandaops.io/builder/2 Next we'd like to test the direct connection path (builder_preferences / getExecutionPayloadBid / beacon_blocks) — so far we've tested it only with kurtosis. If anyone's interested in pointing devnet proposers at a real relay endpoint , we'll open up a public endpoint. Any takers? Yes definitely! Thanks for this, please open the endpoint I'll point all my stake to it also happy to point my stake at you guys 😄 but can you take a look at https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/168, I wanna merge that change on lodestar side but we need to align on this on the spec side in case your http endpoints enforce signed auth to be provided what do clients put for `max_execution_payment` as a default? I made it MAX_EXECUTION_PAYMENT but unsure about it, maybe 0 makes more sense and make it a user responsibility to set it Yes, this works for us. Also approved on github. default is 0 for us, and to configure anything above 0 a user has to add `--allow-dangerous-trusted-payments` flag, users should be aware of the fact that builder can rug pull them if they set this value above 0 Thanks. Will post back here once the endpoint is available. ETA beginning of next week. We'll make it zero by default

excerpts.author: .christn
excerpts.content:
Hey everyone, ultrasound.money team here. 

I heard there was some concern raised in the last acd regarding lack of testing of the relay path for epbs. 

FYI: We have been running our relay on devnet-8 for a while now, mainly testing the builder facing endpoints with our own dummy / test builder.
In absense of any direct connected proposers we published bids via p2p, to test our win / reveal cycle. 
Our staked builder: https://dora.glamsterdam-devnet-8.ethpandaops.io/builder/2

Next we'd like to test the direct connection path (builder_preferences / getExecutionPayloadBid / beacon_blocks) — so far we've tested it only with kurtosis.

 If anyone's interested in pointing devnet proposers at a real relay endpoint , we'll open up a public endpoint. 
Any takers?

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: Yes definitely! Thanks for this, please open the endpoint I'll point all my stake to it

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: also happy to point my stake at you guys 😄 but can you take a look at https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/168, I wanna merge that change on lodestar side but we need to align on this on the spec side in case your http endpoints enforce signed auth to be provided

excerpts.author: stefanbratanov
excerpts.content: what do clients put for `max_execution_payment` as a default? I made it MAX_EXECUTION_PAYMENT but unsure about it, maybe 0 makes more sense and make it a user responsibility to set it

excerpts.author: .christn
excerpts.content: Yes, this works for us. Also approved on github.

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: default is 0 for us, and to configure anything above 0 a user has to add `--allow-dangerous-trusted-payments` flag, users should be aware of the fact that builder can rug pull them if they set this value above 0

excerpts.author: .christn
excerpts.content: Thanks. Will post back here once the endpoint is available. ETA beginning of next week.

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: We'll make it zero by default
